questions.evidence:
TRY A MUSICAL INSTRUMENT: The community music room is offering a free seven-day trial of selected instruments. The offer covers borrowing an instrument, not private lessons. A staff member will show you how to carry and store it before you leave.

Bring a student card and an adult contact number. Each borrower may choose one instrument that is currently available. A waiting list is used when all instruments of a kind are out. Joining the list does not start your seven-day period.

The return date is printed on your receipt when you collect the instrument. Return it during staffed hours, Tuesday to Saturday, from two to six. Please contact the music room before the due date if a problem prevents your return.

The trial is a chance to explore an interest without buying equipment first. The instrument remains the music room's property. Do not pass it to another borrower yourself, even if that person is next on the waiting list; staff must check and record every return.
